svg.title: Preferences: Local Edit Capture, Per-Field Merge and Echo Suppression

g.text: Preferences: Local Edit Capture, Per-Field Merge and Echo Suppression
new revisions only for fields changed locally
save only if local content changed; commit counter
local intent is saved before waiting on cloud I/O
observe the highest record and field counters
capture local edits made during I/O again
allocate revisions after the observed remote counters
validate known fields as a whole, then apply changes
restore this device's published baseline; needsInitialRead = false
Applying remote values may fire the settings subscription,
but with the baseline updated, the next round does not treat it as a local edit.
fill in local values only for fields missing from the merge
new-device defaults never overwrite existing remote fields
save the local merged copy only on change; commit counter
lastObservedValues: baseline for recognizing local edits
Disconnecting resets only the publication baseline and first-read flag;
the local copy for restoring edits is kept.
